sample_metadata.audio_storage: Explicit prepared-displacement vector master + PNG depth export; never the original upload.
sample_metadata.riaa: none (custom reversible presence shelf, not RIAA)
sample_metadata.warning: Raster-limited lo-fi mono. Audio past 4:30 is left off. Not a physical stylus simulator.

vector_master.meaning: Prepared lateral displacement / amp_mm; adaptive-filtered, presence-emphasized, peak-normalized. Not the original upload.

reference_definitions.vector: Prepared mono -> inverse presence shelf only; PCM16 quantization error, no second lowpass.
reference_definitions.png_same_vector: PNG-traced output compared with that same de-emphasized prepared reference; includes raster and cleanup changes.
reference_definitions.png_raster_only: Prepared reference also receives PNG-side adaptive cleanup and inverse shelf; isolates raster loss.
reference_definitions.fullband: Original mono, no cut preparation; gain-fitted comparison. Instrumental test only, not vocals.

vector_format: PCM16 mono WAV of prepared displacement; r = r_nominal + amp_mm * (PCM / 32768), paired JSON metadata and SHA256. Inverse shelf only during vector playback, no second lowpass.
quality_definition: Legacy-named quality_vs_bandlimited_original and quality_vs_fullband_original are PNG-trace metrics. Mono source -> +6 dB minimum-phase shelf -> radius-following Hann STFT filtering -> peak normalization -> groove sample times -> identical decode-side adaptive cleanup and inverse shelf. This measures raster/centroid loss, not full-band fidelity. Gain-aligned SNR and +/-10 ms lag search exclude edge transients. Full-band comparison is separately reported.

visual_fix.preview: RingGeometry with label-radius hole; explicit black albedo 0x141416, roughness .42, metalness 0; dark texture used only for bump, not albedo.
visual_fix.label: Separate brown label at thickness + 0.3 mm with polygonOffset; no coplanar preview overlap.

browser_note: Node mocked renderer/DOM tests exercise real pinned OrbitControls and Three.js camera math, including moved-camera raycast. JS syntax checked. No real browser, WebGL or listening audition; manual visual check remains.
caveats: Vector avoids raster/grid loss but retains the existing adaptive preparation (~3.2–4 kHz on this sample). It cannot recover frequencies already filtered out. Still lo-fi mono.
2x2 subpixel raster averaging reduces grid beating but cannot eliminate all alias/laser artifacts at 4096, especially tight long-track grooves.
Custom presence shelf is not RIAA. Inverse shelf is exact digitally, but raster loss is not reversible.
16-bit PNG stores physical surface heights in inverted visual polarity plus spiral/filter metadata, never hidden PCM/MP3.
Playback prefers the explicit prepared vector master; PNG-only imports trace 65-point radial centroids. Neither path uses the original upload.
New exports use v2 because old v1 decoders silently ignored polarity; this decoder reads both v1 and v2.
Pinned three.js/OrbitControls CDN needs internet; local Python processing and audio are local.
4:30 maximum (longer audio is cut to its first 4:30; older records up to 8 min still open), 150 MB uploads; 2048 option has lower bandwidth and long recordings have subpixel features.
